payload.title: One ProjectContext per command: load configuration and dotenv once, propagate configuration errors
payload.description: From kbs-bbf2a6. load_project_configuration has 73 call sites (71 loads for one kanbus list), re-serialises defaults through YAML each call and mutates the process environment via dotenv each time; root discovery, project-dir resolution and overlay config are redone 3 to 6 times per command; malformed configuration is swallowed (if let Ok / .ok() / unwrap_or_default) and changes behaviour. Build one ProjectContext (root, config path, configuration, project dir, overlay config) at command entry in both runtimes and pass it down; load dotenv once at process start; propagate configuration errors, tolerating only file-not-found. Acceptance: configuration loads once per command (counted in a test); malformed configuration fails with a clear error in both runtimes.
